professionalSummary: Experienced Technical Program Manager with a proven track record in managing bi‑weekly release calendars, reducing merge‑to‑release lead time, and coordinating security fast‑track processes.
experienceHighlights: Ran the fortnightly release calendar for the database product at Corvid Data and chaired the go/no‑go meeting with the leads of the storage, query and console teams.
Kept the dependency board for the three teams and raised blocked items at the weekly engineering directors' sync.
Introduced a merge‑freeze checklist and an automatically drafted set of release notes; median merge‑to‑release lead time in the release tracker went from 19 days in Q1 2023 to 11 days in Q3 2023.
Agreed a fast‑track route with the security team so that critical fixes could ship outside the train once the security lead approved them.
Earned the Project Management Professional (PMP) certification from the Project Management Institute in 2022.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Q3 2023 release review deck, including a per‑release chart of median merge‑to‑release lead time (Q1 2023 median 19 days, Q3 2023 median 11 days) and a method slide defining lead time from merge commit to tagged release.
